data.name: Book Organizer
data.detailed_description:
📚 Key Features

  • The Cozy Satisfaction of Organizing: Feel the delight of sorting books by type and category accompanied by satisfying ASMR audio.

  • Fill Your Own Space: Arrange books neatly onto shelves for maximum organization. Experience true catharsis from a perfectly tidy library!

  • A Balance of Relaxation and Challenge: Enjoy minimal gameplay focused purely on your space with soothing BGM, or take on Hardcore Mode where you must dodge villains and aim for perfection under a time limit.

  • Intuitive 3D Graphics: Newly overhauled clean UI combined with warm, beautifully rendered 3D spaces enhances your immersion.

⚙️ Gameplay Details

1. Diverse Library Management & Difficulty System

Choose a library that fits your skill level and playstyle. Maximize your efficiency by purchasing helpful items like book carts and energy drinks!

  • Town Library: A cozy starter course with 50 books to organize.

  • City Library: Step up your management game with 150 books to sort.

  • Janggyeong Panjeon: A traditional Hanok map embracing Korean beauty! Enjoy deep gameplay sorting 200 items in a serene setting.

  • Expert Mode: Unlocked after clearing at least 1 library! Experience the thrill of organizing 500 books scattered all over the floor of a brand-new city library.

  • 🔥 Incredible Mode: The ultimate challenge unlocked after clearing at least 2 libraries! You’ll need to organize a whopping 1,000 books—yes, ONE THOUSAND books! A true challenge for real organizing masters!

  • 💀 Hardcore Mode: An extreme mode where you must organize 50 books before time runs out! Protect your shelves while dodging 2 villains trying to mess up your flow (a loud phone-talker uncle and a hyperactive spinning ninja)!

2. Museum & Landmark Construction System

Earn tokens every time you complete a library cleanup, and use them to build your very own museum!

  • Sueojangdae: Buy the foundation with tokens, place it, and build it up for immense satisfaction!

  • Gyeonghoeru: An exquisite floating building construction project unlocked after completing Sueojangdae.

3. Steam Achievements Support

Conquer each difficulty level, deal with annoying villains, and complete your landmark museum to unlock achievements and polish your Steam profile!

🎬 Streaming & Content Creation Policy

We wholeheartedly welcome and support content creators streaming or uploading video content of our game! Please keep the following in mind when broadcasting:

  • [Required] Please include the game’s official title in your video or stream title.

  • [Recommended] Including the Steam Store page URL in your video description or stream details gives us huge support!

data.short_description: A cozy 3D shelf-management puzzle game with satisfying ASMR sounds. Organize unique libraries, from a peaceful Hanok map to an Incredible Mode with 1,000 books! Challenge Hardcore Mode with disruptive villains, and earn tokens to build historical landmarks like Gyeonghoeru.
